title: Allow long localized sales and purchase line type captions
summary: Sales and purchase document subforms no longer fail when a localized line type caption is longer than 20 characters, such as the French allocation account caption. A new FormatTypeAsText() returning Text[30] replaces FormatType(): Text[20], which stays as an obsolete wrapper.
key_points: Added FormatTypeAsText() method returning Text[30] to sales, purchase, and standard line tables
Updated UI and lookup paths to use the new 30-character formatting method
Preserved existing FormatType(): Text[20] and OnBeforeFormatType() as obsolete compatibility layers
Introduced new Text[30] events for subscribers needing wider output capacity
Added regression tests covering long localized captions and legacy event precedence
